extraction.policy_summary: EML's Human Rights Policy covers equal opportunity principles aligned with the RPwD Act, 2016, and the Company states it 'thoughtfully considers accessibility requirements and the nature of disabilities across all our plants and office locations, with the objective of fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.' Policy is publicly linked.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: Total differently-abled employees (D+E) = 1 (1 male, 100%; 0 female). Total differently-abled workers (F+G) = 0. Against a total workforce of 3,506 employees and 19,949 workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: 'All campuses feature accessible workspaces, with necessary infrastructure such as ramps, sidewalks, and elevators installed in both corporate offices and plants... Appropriate signboards are strategically placed throughout the premises to assist employees and workers with hearing impairments. Additionally, wheelchairs are available at Occupational Health Centres across all major facilities.'
extraction.culture_practices_details: 'Disability support and assistance' is listed as one of the ongoing health/welfare benefits offered to all full-time employees, alongside life insurance, medical/healthcare benefits, and wellness camps. No further detail on what this benefit comprises, and no ERG or flexible-work arrangement specific to PwD is named.
extraction.compliance_details: Filing answers the mandated BRSR RPwD Act question affirmatively and with specificity: 'Yes. All campuses feature accessible workspaces, with necessary infrastructure such as ramps, sidewalks, and elevators installed in both corporate offices and plants to support differently abled employees and visitors in compliance with the Disabilities Act, 2016.' No statutory employment quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is stated.
